request: Analyze GSE297515 for PMID 41775886 (Piezo1-dependent activation of stromal cells ignites muscle inflammation in exercise and injury and is associated with inflammaging.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: effect of a 90-min treadmill bout (AEX), MmSCs sorted from pooled hindlimb muscle 1 day later, vs sedentary on MmSC gene expression (WT C57BL/6J mice)
planned_contrasts: AEX vs SED, sorted MmSCs, n=3 vs 3 (Fig.1c); no DEG count given; highlighted genes Tnc, Ccn4, Postn, Timp1, F2rl1, Ccl2, Ccl7
final.paper_method: DESeq2 (median of ratios) + apeglm LFC shrinkage; DEG padj<0.05; volcano highlights |FC|>=2
final.sample_inclusion: WT mice, sorted MmSCs, n=3 per arm; replicates with r<0.9 removed
final.other_sub_series: CTX injury, Yoda1 culture, Piezo1 cKO, whole muscle, heart, liver: other estimands

paper_results.Fig.1c: volcano plot; no numeric DEG count in text or legend

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p2; FIG7 (c); S4.7.p1: STAR + featureCounts; DESeq2 median-of-ratios; replicates with Pearson r<0.9 removed; genes with <10 reads within any condition removed; DESeq2 + apeglm shrinkage; DEGs = adjusted P<0.05.

checks: series contact CBDM, Harvard Medical School (authors' lab)
sorted MmSC population RNA-seq, mouse, matches S4.7.p1

ownership.reasoning: DA.p1 deposits sorted-MmSC transcriptomes in GSE297515; titles matching ^WT_(sed|exe)#\d$ are the Fig.1c MmSC samples (n=3 per arm, FIG7).

matrix.reasoning: integer fraction 1.0, max 3.07e6, median 0; GEO data_processing: featureCounts, 'raw read counts for each Sample'; paper S4.7.p1 runs DESeq2 on featureCounts counts.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal GEO titles (90/90). Keep only the Fig.1k samples; group from title. Replicate Pearson r on log2CPM >= 0.96, so the paper's r<0.9 QC removes none.

design.reasoning: Fig.1k: EXT vs SED in independent mice, one factor.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals from one experiment, no pairing; paper fit ~ group.

deviations: pydeseq2 instead of R DESeq2; pydeseq2 lfc_shrink stands in for apeglm
paper low-count rule implemented in prep/filter_low_counts.py (keep a gene when any condition sums to >= 10 reads)

method.reasoning: Raw featureCounts counts support the paper's DESeq2 route.

final.deviation_note: Legends say |FC| >= 2 (applied); S2.1.p2 text says |FC| > 2. Audit: padj<0.05 alone (S4.7.p1 DEG definition).

threshold.reasoning: FIG7 (c,k): DEGs highlighted at Padj<0.05 and |FC|>=2, i.e. |log2FC| >= 1.

caveats: paper reports no DEG count, only highlighted genes
FC cutoff applied to shrunken LFC, as in the paper

study.reasoning: Fig.1k reproduced with the paper's model and threshold.

executions.name: grp_EXT_vs_SED
executions.reasoning: Fig.1k two-group DESeq2 as in S4.7.p1

enrichment.reasoning: S2.1.p2 pathway analysis, S4.7.p2 fgsea; kept separate from DE.

final.primary_estimand: AEX (day 1) vs SED effect on MmSC expression within Pdgfra-Cre Piezo1 WT and within Piezo1 f/f (stromal cKO) mice; Piezo1 dependence read from the two responses
planned_contrasts: AEX d1 vs SED in WT (Fig.4e)
AEX d1 vs SED in Piezo1 cKO (Fig.4e)
Fig.4e clusters = genes with Padj<0.05 in either; cluster sizes not in text
final.paper_method: DESeq2 + apeglm (S4.7.p1); k-means clustering in Morpheus
final.sample_inclusion: Pdgfra-Cre+ Piezo1 WT vs f/f littermates, sorted MmSCs, n=3 per cell

paper_results.Fig.4e: k-means clusters; 'hundreds of genes' impaired in mutant (S2.4.p1); no counts in text

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.4.p1; FIG10 (e). S4.7.p1: STAR + featureCounts; DESeq2 median-of-ratios; replicates with Pearson r<0.9 removed; genes with <10 reads within any condition removed; DESeq2 + apeglm shrinkage; DEGs = adjusted P<0.05.

checks: series contact CBDM, Harvard Medical School (authors' lab)
sorted MmSC population RNA-seq, mouse, matches S4.7.p1

ownership.reasoning: DA.p1; titles Pdgfra.CRE_Piezo1.{WT,FL}_{SED,AEXd1}#1-3 are the Fig.4e MmSC samples (n=3 per cell).

matrix.reasoning: integer fraction 1.0, max 3.07e6, median 0; GEO data_processing: featureCounts, 'raw read counts for each Sample'; paper S4.7.p1 runs DESeq2 on featureCounts counts.
